sec: sec:C010: Third-party testing for harmful outputs

blocks.id: blk:C010: Third-party testing for harmful outputs/1
blocks.text: Appoint expert third parties to evaluate system robustness to harmful outputs including distressed outputs, angry responses, high-risk advice, offensive content, bias, and deception at least every 3 months.
